map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-13 03:00): early in person 7,044 (state 6,931); ballots sent 15,087 (state 14,467). Clermont (as of 2026-10-13 11:58): mail returned 603 (state 549); early in person 3,536 (state 3,191). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-12 17:04): early in person 8,074 (state 8,027). Franklin (as of 2026-10-13 00:11): mail returned 5,575 (state 5,572); early in person 15,999 (state 15,630); ballots sent 74,255 (state 73,079). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-12 19:07): ballots returned, any method 15,622 (state 15,516). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-13 08:44): mail returned 854 (state 798).
